data.topic: Dimensional reduction for anyons in the average-field approximation
data.speaker: 杨绮云
data.speakerBio: 杨绮云现为西班牙毕尔巴鄂巴斯克应用数学中心(Basque Center for Applied Mathematics, BCAM)博士后研究员,博士毕业于法国里昂高等师范学校(École normale supérieure de Lyon)。其主要研究方向为与任意子(anyons)相关的偏微分方程问题,涵盖多体量子系统、Chern–Simons–Schrödinger方程以及不同数学模型之间的联系;同时研究费米子系统,涉及Hartree–Fock方程、Lipkin模型等。目前已在Annales Henri Poincaré等国际学术期刊发表论文三篇。
data.abstract: We study Abelian anyons at the mean-field/almost-bosonic level, whose dynamics are governed by the Chern–Simons–Schrödinger system. We consider the dimensional reduction of this 2D model by introducing an anisotropic trapping potential and derive an effective 1D model after tracing out the tightly confined direction, whose dynamics are described by a quintic defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation. We rigorously establish this reduction for ground-state energies and time-dependent solutions, under a uniform H^2 well-posedness assumption. This provides a natural way to understand how the statistical structure of a 2D anyon system is reflected in its 1D effective description.

data.speakerBio:
陆铭，上海交通大学安泰经济管理学院讲席教授、教育部国家级人才称号获得者、中国发展研究院执行院长、中国城市治理研究院研究员、上海国际金融与经济研究院研究员。担任民建上海市委副主委和第十四届全国政协委员。
曾工作于复旦大学，曾作为富布莱特学者工作于美国哈佛大学和国家经济研究局
（NBER）。曾担任世界银行和亚洲开发银行咨询专家。著有专著《大国治理》和
《空间的力量》等，以及学术科普著作《大国大城》、《向心城市》。研究领域为中国经济、城乡和区域经济发展、劳动经济学。近年来的研究主要是对城市和区域发展政策进行评估，并为城市可持续发展，促进国内市场一体化和经济持续增长提供来自空间政治经济学的战略思考。
data.abstract:
提要：预测未来人口空间分布有利于有效配置公共资源，且有助于商业
选址。在过去10 余年的时间里，我们用多种方法去预测了中国人口空间分布，
其中齐夫法则是非常重要的研究基础。近来的研究中，我们利用全球多个国家和
地区的数据考察了经济发展、市场一体化和齐夫法则之间的关系。并且在结构式
模型中模拟了当劳动成本力下降对人口空间分布的影响。这些研究共同指向一个
结论，随着时间推移和劳动力市场一体化水平的提高，齐夫法则将接近完美呈现。

data.speaker: 罗永
data.speakerBio: 罗永,博士毕业于香港理工大学,吉林大学数学学院鼎新学者。主要研究方向为退化抛物方程 BV 熵解的定性理论。
data.abstract: A proper restriction at infinity on the inner source or initial data can affect the lifespan (the minimal blow-up time) of classical solutions to the Cauchy problem for semilinear heat equations. In this talk, we investigate this property under the following two cases: (a) non-rarefied inner source at infinity with zero initial data; (b) scaling inner source and initial data. Sharp lifespan estimates are derived in both settings. This work is joint with Prof. Jingxue Yin and Dr. Liting You. Joint work with Yijia Fang (NUS).

data.topic: Global existence of weak solutions to a parabolic attraction-repulsion chemotaxis model in three dimensions
data.speaker: 谢佳佑
data.speakerBio: 中山大学数学学院(珠海)副教授。在台湾大学获得数学博士学位。曾在香港城市大学、台湾理论科学中心以及香港中文大学从事过博士后研究工作。研究重点为偏微分方程的分析,其应用领域包括离子输运和趋化现象,相关论文发表在Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. ,SIAM J. Math. Anal. ,J. Differential Equations 等国际重要期刊。
data.abstract: We consider the Cauchy problem for a fully parabolic attraction-repulsion chemotaxis model in three spatial dimensions. Due to the interplay of diffusion, aggregation and repulsion effects, solutions to the model may either exist globally or blow up in finite time. It is natural to expect that solutions exist globally in time when the chemorepellent dominates. While global existence was previously known only in two dimensions, in this work we establish the global existence of weak solutions for the repulsive dominant case in three dimensions. Joint work with Yijia Fang (NUS).

data.title: 勷勤数学•专家报告-吴楚芬
data.topic: Sharp minimal wave speed in a nonlocal lattice nutrient-prey-predator system with nutrient recycling and mixotrophy
data.speaker: 吴楚芬
data.speakerBio: 吴楚芬,教授,硕士生导师,主要从事微分方程理论及其应用研究,曾获得广东省教学成果奖一等奖3项,与合作者在Journal of Differential Equations、Journal of Dynamics and Differential Equations、Physica D: Nonlinear Phenomen、Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society、Proceedings of the Royal Society of Edinburgh:Section A Mathematics等杂志发表论文40多篇,其中ESI热点与高被引论文2篇,主持国家自然科学基金4项,省部级项目3项。
data.abstract: We study traveling waves in a nonlocal lattice nutrient-prey-predator system with predator-mediated nutrient recycling and mixotrophic growth. The dispersal operator has an arbitrary finite interaction radius, leading to a noncooperative mixed-type wave system with multiple advanced and delayed arguments. We establish a sharp minimal wave speed characterized by the characteristic equation at the predator-free equilibrium. For supercritical speeds, positive semi-waves are constructed by a fixed point argument. A Harnack-type estimate, blow-up translations, and tangential exponential comparisons yield uniform boundedness of the predator. Strong uniform persistence is obtained by combining translation compactness with a tail estimate, a critical exponential moment argument, and a two-sided Laplace transform. An adapted Lyapunov functional then proves convergence to the positive coexistence equilibrium. Compactness gives a wave at the critical speed. For subcritical speeds, a reversed tail estimate and a negative one-sided Laplace transform yield a positive real root of the characteristic equation, contradicting the strict positivity of the corresponding characteristic function on $\mathbb R$.

data.speakerBio: 山东大学教授(二级),国家高层次人才计划入选者。2004年于山东大学获理学博士学位;2008年于美国斯坦福大学从事博士后研究工作。回国后,先后入选教育部新世纪优秀人才,获山东省自然科学杰出青年基金资助,被聘为山东省泰山学者特聘专家,入选国家级领军人才。主要从事数论中自守形式与素数分布的研究,成果刊于Math. Ann., Adv. Math., IMRN, Sci. Math. China等数学期刊。2011年获教育部自然科学一等奖;2014年获国家自然科学二等奖。
data.abstract: The Hardy-Littlewood-Chowla conjecture states that the Möbius function displays cancellation along primes shifted by 2. This problem, which can be traced back to at least Hildebrand's work in 1989, serves as a well-known model for the parity problem in sieve theory. In this talk, we present a proof of this conjecture and explain the core ideas behind the argument. As a consequence, the Möbius function attains the values +1 and −1 with equal asymptotic frequency among squarefree shifted primes. This is joint work with Zhiwei Wang and Jie Wu.

data.location: 大学城校园文二栋301会议室
data.speaker: 钟远光
data.speakerAffiliation: 华南理工大学工商管理学院
data.speakerBio: 钟远光,华南理工大学工商管理学院副院长,二级教授,兴华杰出学者,博士生导师。教育部工业工程类教学指导委员会委员、中国运筹学会行为运筹学与行为运营管理分会副理事长、管理科学与工程协会理事、中国系统工程学会智能制造系统工程专业委员会委员等。长期致力于供应链库存优化、库存共享与分配、优化理论方法与应用、平台运营等领域的研究,代表性论文发表在MS、OR、MSOM、POM等期刊上。主持国家自科青年A类项目,面上项目和青年C类项目(结题均为特优)以及南网技术、广州供电局、扬腾科技等企业委托项目。入选教育部高层次人才计划青年学者,获得教育部高等学校科学研究优秀成果三等奖,广东省哲学社会科学优秀成果奖一等奖和二等奖,安徽省科学技术奖三等奖,OMEGA Best Paper等奖励。
data.abstract: This talk covers two works. The first one examines joint pricing strategies for an online retailer offering multiple substitutable products through presale (deposit + final payment) and traditional instant-purchase channels. Using a nested multinomial logit (nested-MNL) framework, it relaxes the IIA assumption by capturing correlated substitution within the same product across channels. Closed-form expressions are derived for optimal prices, profits, and market shares. The analysis explores channel interdependence, product entry effects, heterogeneous price sensitivity, and limited inventory, with a case study on synthetic and real transaction data from a leading retailer demonstrating substantial profit gains. The second paper addresses a multi-period shared-inventory system with a centralized warehouse that replenishes stock ex ante and allocates it across zones ex post after observing demand. Demand exhibits both intra-period dependence (across zones) and inter-period dependence (over time). Under a conditional full-information benchmark, the joint replenishment-allocation problem follows an order-up-to policy based on aggregate demand's conditional mean and variance, separating risk-pooling benefits from forecast-updating effects. A residual-based multistage distributionally robust optimization (DRO) framework preserves the time-series dependence structure, yielding a tractable affine-policy LP approximation with finite-sample out-of-sample guarantees.

data.title: 华师经英Seminar第70期
data.topic: Data Centers and Firm Productivity
data.speaker: 陈邱惠
data.speakerBio: 陈邱惠,经济学博士,华南师范大学经济与管理学院副研究员。研究方向聚焦制度与发展经济学、中国经济增长与转型。论文成果发表于《经济研究》《经济学(季刊)》等期刊,主持国家自然科学基金项目、中国博士后基金项目等。
data.abstract: We evaluate the impact of access to data centers on firm productivity using a novel facility-level database from China. We construct a market access measure for computing power and use spatial variation in renewable energy potential, which affects computing production costs, to predict data center locations and construct a nature-based instrument for computing accessibility. We find that computing accessibility raises the productivity of listed firms. The gains are concentrated among firms with high computing demand and among medium-sized and large firms. Higher digital technology adoption and lower fixed-asset intensity are consistent with lower barriers to digital applications and the substitution of externally provided services for in-house infrastructure. The effect of accessibility on productivity is U-shaped in distance and also holds at the prefecture-city level. These findings highlight the enduring role of geography in the digital economy and its implications for the spatial allocation of computing infrastructure.

data.title: 物理学院学术报告（第66期）University of New South Wales，Prof. Dimitrie Culcer
data.topic: Orbital-geometric spin response: inter-band coherence versus orbital-to-spin conversion
data.speaker: Dimitrie Culcer
data.speakerBio: Dimitrie Culcer obtained his PhD from the University of Texas at Austin in 2005. He worked as a postdoctoral research fellow first at Argonne National Laboratory between 2006-2008, and subsequently at the University of Maryland, College Park, 2008-2010. He became a faculty member at the University of Science and Technology of China in Hefei in 2010, where he was a member of the International Center for Quantum Design of Functional Materials. In 2013 he moved to the University of New South Wales in Sydney where he is currently a Professor. In 2019 he was awarded a Future Fellowship by the Australian Research Council. Dimi Culcer's research interests include quantum computing, spin-orbit coupling and topological effects in condensed matter physics, quantum transport theory and nonlinear electrical and optical effects, with a focus on topological materials. He is actively working in all these areas.
data.abstract: Orbitronics seeks to convert orbital angular momentum (OAM) into spin, but its microscopic dynamics is not inderstood. A steady-state OAM density accompanied by spin-orbit coupling (SOC) is expected to generate a spin density, which ultimately exerts a torque on the magnetization. Yet it remains unknown whether the OAM response,as understood by the modem theory of orbital magnetization, is an intermediate variable controlling spin generation. In this talk I will discuss a general method for identifying the quantum geometric component of the non-quilibrium spin response stemming explicitly from orbital dynamics. Starting from a spinless parent Hamiltonian with strong inter-band dynamics, I show that adding SOC gives rise to a direct term and an orbital geometric spin response (OGSR) due to parent inter-band coherence. In untilted massive Dirac fermions the OGSRsurvives as the net OAM vanishes, and generates counterflow, opposing the direct response. At weak SOC, the leading OGSR in this model is linear in SOC, while the first identifiable OAM-derived terms appear at second order. Spin can therefore be generated through orbital-geometric channels without the modern-theory OAM. response acting as an intermediate dynamical variable. These results provide guidelines for optimising orbitronic systems. I will also discuss extensions to models of Weyl semimetals. Preliminary calculations indicate that the orbital-geometric contribution can dominate selected components of the electrically induced spin density. Its nagnitude and sign depend on the physical-spin texture, SOC and carrier occupation, suggesting a route to dentifying systems in which spin generation is governed predominantly by orbital geometry.

data.title: 物理学院学术报告（第63期）南京大学杜灵杰至诚特聘教授
data.topic: 分数量子霍尔效应中涌现的新物理——从"手性引力子"到"部分子"
data.speaker: 杜灵杰
data.speakerBio: 杜灵杰,南京大学至诚特聘教授、物理学院博士生导师。主要围绕拓扑关联系统中的新型量子物态,基于 lIlV 族量子阱体系在极低温强磁场下开展光学与输运实验研究,原创性的成果包括:1 )观察到引力子模; 2 )探测到分数物态的部分子; 3 )揭示激子拓扑序等,相关工作以通讯作者身份在《 Nature 》和《 Nature Physics 》等期刊发表。领衔完成的成果入选"中国科学十大进展"和"中国十大科技进展新闻"等。荣获中国青年五四奖章和陈嘉庚青年科学奖等。
data.abstract: 分数量子霍尔效应中,二维度规的量子涨落引出了引力子的凝聚态类比:手性引力子 ( 即引力子模 ) ,这种准粒子是自旋 2 的基本模式激发。在本次报告中,我将讨论近期在砷化镓量子阱上进行的圆偏振非弹性光散射实验。在半填充附近的一系列分数态,我们首次观察到引力子模。之后,我们将实验扩展到了四分之一填充;在 v = 2/7 和 v = 2/9 ,除了之前观察到的低能引力子模,光散射谱还揭示出一种新的高能引力子模(也被称为 Haldane 模)。这种有能隙的高能引力子在 v = 1/4 的无能隙非费米液体中也被观测到,揭示了隐藏在高能区的玻色型分数态。高能引力子模的发现超越了传统的复合费米子图像,并指出在强关联拓扑系统中的电子可涌现式地"分解"为若干类夸克准粒子 ( 即部分子 ) ;这在实验上首次证实了这种部分子是真实存在的准粒子。这些实验结果表明,引力子模是源自部分子的几何激发,并证实了分数量子霍尔效应的新几何理论以及部分子图像。

data.topic: The Product of Intersecting Families
data.speaker: 吴河辉
data.speakerBio: 吴河辉,现为复旦大学上海数学中心长聘教授,2011年获得美国伊利诺伊大学博士学位,现主持国自然青年A类项目、面上项目,曾入选国家高层次人才计划、上海市曙光学者等项目资助,受邀在欧洲组合大会做大会报告。在结构图论、极值组合领域证明了包括Fouquet-Jolivet 猜想,Ohba猜想、Kalai-Meshulam猜想等数学公开难题。多篇文章被JEMS、JCTB、Combinatorica、Forum Math Sigma等数学著名期刊发表。
data.abstract: For integers $k, ℓ \ge 2$ let $m(k, ℓ)$ denote the maximum of $|F||G|$ where the maximum is taken over all pairs of cross-intersecting families, $F$ being a $k$-graph with covering number $ℓ$ and $G$ a $ℓ$-graph with covering number k (see the paper for the definitions). Erdos and Lov\'asz initiated the study of the one family version. That is, they provided lower and upper bounds on the maximal size $m(k) = |F|$ where $F$ is an intersecting k-graph with covering number $k$. In many similar situations m$(k, k) = m(k)^2$ holds. However, as our results show $m(k, k)/m(k)^2$ is tending to infinity as $k$ grows. For $k > k_0$ we establish the exact value $m(k, l) = (l^{k−1} + l − 1)(k^{l-1}+k-1)$ when $1<<\log k<l< 2^k$. As to smaller values we prove $m(3, 3) = 121$ and determine $m(2, k)=k2^k$ for all $k ≥ 2$ .

data.topic: Extremal Kt-intersecting graph families for large t
data.speaker: 黄皓
data.speakerBio: 黄皓,2000-2003就读于华南师大附中,2007年本科毕业于北大数学科学院,2012年加州大学洛杉矶分校获数学博士学位。现任新加坡国立大学数学系副教授。曾获斯隆研究奖、美国NSF CAREER Award和ICBS前沿科学奖。曾于2019年证明布尔函数的"敏感度猜想"。其研究领域包括极值组合学、概率/代数方法、谱图理论和理论计算机科学等。
data.abstract: In this talk, I will discuss a proof of the following theorem: for sufficiently large positive integer t and every integer n≥t, the maximum density of a Kt-intersecting family G of graphs on vertex set [n] is equal to 2 − t(t − 1)/2. Furthermore, when the equality is attained, G must consist of all graphs on [n] that contain some fixed copy of Kt. This result settles a conjecture of Ellis, Filmus, and Friedgut for large t. If time permits, I will also discuss a short and novel proof for the odd-cycle-intersecting case. Joint work with Yijia Fang (NUS).

data.speakerBio: Dr. Ting Xie obtained his PhD. in Molecular Biology and Biochemistry from Rutgers University. Currently, he is the chair professor of stem cell biology in the School of Biological Sciences and the director of the Institute of Regenerative Medicine and Longevity Sciences at the University of Hong Kong. Previously, he was Chair Professor, Kerry Holdings Professor of Science, and Hong Kong STEM Professor, the director of the Center for Tissue Regeneration and Engineering, and the associate director of the Shenzhen Peking University-HKUST Medical Center at Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST). Before HKUST, he was a senior investigator at the Stowers Institute for Medical Research and a full professor at the University of Kansas Medical Center. His main research area is stem cell biology. He is one of the leaders and pioneers in studying the stem cell niche and its mechanisms controlling self-renewal. Dr. Xie was among the first to experimentally demonstrate the existence of the stem cell niche. He is also the first to propose and demonstrate the existence of a distinct niche known as the differentiation niche for controlling stem cell lineage differentiation. His laboratory has further elucidated how the two niches work together to control stem cell development, tissue regeneration, and aging. Dr. Xie's laboratory uses Drosophila ovarian stem cells as a model system to elucidate niche structures and functions and the mechanisms underlying self-renewal, differentiation, stem cell competition and aging. Additionally, his lab has demonstrated the roles of various signaling pathways (BMP, Hh, Wnt, Notch and cAMP-PKA), cadherin-mediated cell adhesion, epigenetic factors, non-coding RNAs and various protein complexes (COP9, CCR4-NOT and elf4) in the regulation of self-renewal and differentiation. Recently, his lab has also been using mice to uncover the molecular mechanisms underlying human degenerative eye diseases and further develop stem cell and gene therapies for these diseases, including AMD and glaucoma. Dr. Xie has published over 80 articles in high-profile journals, including Science, Nature and Cell. He received Hudson Award in 2003 and has been serving on the scientific advisory.

data.speaker: 何敏权
data.speakerAffiliation: 香港星量智宇有限公司
data.speakerBio: 何敏权,香港星量智宇有限公司创始人,获香港大学物理学博士学位。主要从事量子算法、量子模拟及人工智能与量子计算的交叉研究,关注量子计算方法的设计与应用,以及人工智能辅助的量子系统建模与模拟,探索两类计算方法相结合的理论与应用潜力 。
data.abstract: The Schwinger model provides an important testbed for exploring gauge-theory phenomena such as confinement and string breaking. However, repeated simulations across different physical parameters and system sizes can be computationally demanding. In this talk, I will introduce a neural-network-based framework for implicit quantum simulation. Rather than learning a separate representation for each parameter setting, the network learns a mapping from model parameters to physical observables using a limited set of simulation data. Once trained, it enables rapid predictions across a continuous parameter domain without retraining. Taking the Schwinger model as an example, I will present the framework ' s predictive performance and examine its ability to generalize beyond the training range and across system sizes. I will also discuss its potential integration with quantum simulation platforms and its broader application to quantum many-body problems.

data.topic: 中国科创债券的发行定价之谜——基于债券市场"科技板"的证据
data.location: 大学城校园文二栋301会议室
data.speaker: 张凯亮
data.speakerBio: 张凯亮,会计学博士,暨南大学管理学院会计系讲师。博士毕业于复旦大学管理学院,耶鲁大学管理学院海外联合培养。主要研究领域是债务契约、债券市场、银行信贷与公司财务,相关论文发表于《管理世界》。主持首批国家自然科学基金青年学生基础研究项目(博士研究生)和国家自然科学基金青年科学基金项目(C类)。
data.abstract: 债券市场"科技板"是我国构建科技金融体制的关键举措,有助于债券市场服务国家创新驱动发展战略和产业转型升级。全球范围内,科技创新活动具有高风险与高不确定性,而我国科技创新债券(科创债券)的发行定价却呈现出"高风险"与"低利率"并存的独特现象。对此,本文探究了我国科创债券的发行定价机理与经济后果。研究发现,相较于非科创债券,科创债券具有显著更低的发行利差,并且这一现象主要集中在交易所债券市场,而非银行间债券市场。机制分析表明,交易所债券市场中活跃的科创债券做市和科创债券ETF交易制度有效提高了科创债券流动性,降低了科创债券流动性溢价,从而降低了科创债券发行利差。异质性分析表明,当债券发行人科创属性更强、地区科创水平更高及发行人信用风险更低时,科创债券流动性效应更加显著。经济后果检验发现,公司发行科创债券后,其研发投入水平显著提升,表明科创债券能够有效支持公司科技创新活动。本文从创新型交易制度设计视角为我国科创债券发行定价之谜提供了理论解释,揭示了市场流动性供给机制在科创债券定价中的关键作用,为我国进一步推动科技金融战略提供了重要的政策启示。

data.abstract: 物态调控是当前科学研究的重要前沿方向之一。随着拓扑能带理论的发展,拓扑的概念被用于调控声波的能带,从而提供了全新的、多样化的声场调控手段。这些拓扑声场受非平庸体能带的保护,在传播过程中不受杂质和无序的影响。声子晶体结构宏观、热力学稳定及实验便利性,使其成为发现新型拓扑态及其拓扑传输现象的重要载体为拓扑物理在声学领域的率先应用奠定了基础,从而实现对声场的创新性调控。本报告主要介绍声子晶体中的拓扑半金属和拓扑绝缘体,及其在片上弹性波和水声中的潜在应用,包括 :(1) 实现多种声学拓扑半金属,观测到表面态的鲁棒性传输和拓扑负折射等传输行为 ;(2) 提出新机制构建各种声学拓扑绝缘体,观测到螺旋边缘态和拓扑角态,以及界面态的负折射和三维分流等传输行为 ;(3) 实现片上多通道分流、传输通道切换和频分复用等功能,利用高阶拓扑角态操控微粒。

data.topic: Generative AI as a Competitor: Content Creation and Platform Strategy
data.location: 大学城校园文2栋301会议室
data.speaker: 陈丽梅
data.speakerAffiliation: 华南师范大学经济与管理学院
data.speakerBio: 陈丽梅,华南师范大学经济与管理学院青年英才,复旦大学经济学博士。主要研究领域为产业组织理论、契约理论、微观经济理论等,主要聚焦数字经济和数字平台等相关话题,具体包括平台激励机制设计、平台自我优待问题、平台数据使用等话题。研究成果发表在重要国际期刊,主持国家自然科学基金青年项目1项。
data.abstract: With advances in generative AI, content platforms increasingly use creators' output as training data to supply their own AI-generated content, which can compete with those same creators for consumer attention. This paper therefore studies how a content platform manages human-content production under this tension by adjusting its revenue-sharing rule and choosing its AI strategy. We develop a game-theoretical model where a content platform hosts two creators and operates its own AI system, which learns from creators' output and competes with them. We obtain four main findings: First, revenue sharing shapes both creator investment and AI's competitive role, making the optimal rule regime-dependent. As AI learning capability increases, optimal sharing follows a discontinuous and nonmonotonic path across four regimes in the contested market: strict AI exclusion, boundary exclusion, active AI competition with both creators, and active AI competition with only one creator remaining. Second, AI supply can either improve or reduce human-content quality under optimal sharing, depending critically on AI capability. Average quality can be lowest at intermediate capability rather than when AI is strongest. Third, although supplying AI content is always beneficial, the platform may restrain AI capability to protect the human-content base and keep AI and both creators active in the contested market. Finally, allowing creators to defend their returns by reallocating investment toward audience relationships can prevent their exit from the contested market and give the platform scope to develop AI to the technological frontier.

data.speakerBio:

data.speaker: 李佳傲
data.speakerBio: 李佳傲,南开大学数学科学学院,教授,博士生导师,应用数学系系主任。本科和硕士毕业于中国科学技术大学,博士毕业于美国西弗吉尼亚大学(导师为赖虹建教授)。主要研究兴趣是图论组合与离散数学,已完成和发表论文三十余篇,研究成果发表在J. Combin. Theory Ser. B, SIAM J. Discrete Math, J. Graph Theory 等杂志。担任天津市数学会秘书长,中国运筹学会图论组合分会理事,以及SCI杂志Journal of Combinatorial Optimization的副编辑(Associate Editor)等学术兼职。入选天津市青年人才托举工程,南开大学百名青年学科带头人培养计划。先后获得了国家自然科学基金面上项目和青年项目(青B、青C)的资助。2024年获中国运筹学会青年科技奖。
data.abstract: The problem of bounding the chromatic number of a graph with small clique number and large minimum degree has received much attention since it was proposed by Erd\H{o}s and Simonovits in1970s. Solving an Erd\H{o}s problem, Brandt and Thomass\'{e} in 2000s proved that every maximal triangle-free graph with minimum degree strictly greater than $\frac{n}{3}$ is a blow-up of a Vega graph and hence is $4$-colorable. They asked to determine the minimum $k$ such that every $n$-vertex triangle-free graph with minimum degree $\frac{n}{3}$ is $k$-colorable. We settle this problem by proving that every triangle-free graph with minimum degree at least $\frac{n}{3}$ is $4$-colorable. The number four is best possible, and our result also extends to general $K_r$-free graphs. Our proofs employ the recent strong Brandt--Thomass\'{e} theorem of \L uczak, Polcyn, and Reiher.

data.speaker: 季向东
data.speakerAffiliation: 上海交通大学李政道研究所
data.speakerBio: 季向东 , 上海交通大学李政道研究所鸿文讲席教授,暗物质物理全国重点实验室常务副主任。1987年获 Drexel 大学博士学位。曾在加州理工学院,麻省理工学院和马里兰大学任职。主要从事量子色动力学( QCD )与核子结构的理论研究。引进了"推广部分子分布函数"描写质子的3D 结构,并用其来研究核子的质量、自旋和力学性质。发现并命名了一类新的物理过程—深虚康普顿散射—来进行质子成像,得到实验证实,成为下一代电子离子对撞机( EIC, EicC )的主要物理目标之一。他提出的大动量有效量子场论( LaMET )开创了用强相互作用第一性原理(格点 QCD )计算费曼( Feynman )部分子分布函数和核子光速运行性质的新领域。2009年起,在上海交通大学开创锦屏地下实验室 PandaX 暗物质与中微子液氙探测实验,推动我国液氙暗物质直接探测进入国际前沿,多次取得国际领先的实验成果。 获得的奖项和荣誉包括:美国物理学会会士 , 德国洪堡研究奖( Humbolt Research Award ),美国杰弗森科学协会杰出核物理学家奖,美国物理学会 Herman Feshbach 奖,教育部自然科学一等奖,上海交通大学睿远科技大奖之数学和物质科学奖。
data.abstract: 爱因斯坦 "如果追上一束光,你会看到什么？"的思想实验,是狭义相对论诞生的原初动机之一。然而,如何建立一个能够描写光速运行体系的相对论量子理论,却成为此后百余年来物理学家不断探索的理论难题。历经狄拉克( Dirac )、温伯格( Weinberg )、费曼( Feynman )、威尔逊( Wilson )等人的持续探索,其中的理论困难逐渐明朗。大动量有效场理论( LaMET )应用威尔逊关于相变临界点的思想并结合他的非微扰格点量子场论的方法,首次建立了完整回答爱因斯坦问题的理论框架,使光速运行质子的夸克和胶子结构能够从量子色动力学第一性原理进行计算。大规模数值量子场论模拟的结果可以通过五十多年来高能实验的精确测量进行定量检验。

data.topic: 以碰撞成像原子核:迈向核物理的统一范式
data.speaker: 贾江涌
data.speakerBio: 贾江涌,纽约州立大学石溪分校(石溪大学)教授。现为 RHIC 上的 STAR 实验和 LHC 上的 ATLAS 实验合作组成员,曾为 RHIC 上的 PHENIX 实验合作组成员;研究兴趣广泛,涵盖高能核物理和粒子物理。其主要专长为从小碰撞系统到大碰撞系统中的集体流、流体力学和粒子关联。1997年获中国科学技术大学学士学位,2003年获石溪大学博士学位,随后在哥伦比亚大学从事博士后研究,2006年加入石溪大学。
data.abstract: 由于强相互作用的非微扰性质,数十年来,核物理一直分为若干相对独立的研究方向 --从核子结构到原子核形变,再到夸克–胶子等离子体( QGP )的形成--彼此之间交流很少。本报告介绍"碰撞成像"( imaging-by-smashing )这一旨在实现统一的实验范式。该范式以原子核碰撞为跨尺度探针,将这些传统上相互分隔的领域连接起来。原子核以极端相对论速度相撞时,其结构信息(原子核形状、密度分布和部分子组态)会在碰撞的初始几何中留下印记,并历经 QGP 演化得以保留,最终体现在可测量的末态粒子分布中。报告还将概述结构信息编码与解码的概念框架,并讨论这一技术如何在核物理以往相互孤立的各领域之间,架起跨越从 MeV 到 TeV 能标的桥梁。

data.abstract: Classical equivariant bordism theories require computing the full collection of equivariant characteristic numbers to detect whether an equivariant manifold bounds equivariantly or not. In this talk, we consider simplified equivariant bordism characterizations for two families of equivariant manifolds with isolated fixed points: unitary T^k-manifolds and closed smooth (Z2)^k-manifolds. For a unitary T^k-manifold M with isolated fixed points, we establish an equivariant unitary bordism criterion built entirely from a single polynomial of equivariant Chern classes.

data.speakerBio: 吴笛,华中师范大学副教授。博士毕业于武汉大学以及巴黎七大,此后,分别在蒙彼利埃大学IMAG研究所以及北京大学数学科学学院从事博士后工作。主要的研究方向为Navier-Stokes方程的正则性、边界层理论、流体中的匀质化问题,研究成果发表于CPAM, PLMS, JMPA等期刊,获批国家级青年人才计划,主持国家自然科学基金多项。
data.abstract: Understanding the transition mechanism of boundary layer flows is of great significance in physics and engineering, especially due to the current development of supersonic and hypersonic aircraft. In this talk, we introduce multiple unstable acoustic modes, which play a crucial role during the early stage of transition in the supersonic boundary layer. We also consider the subsonic inviscid spectral instability of the two-dimensional non-isentropic compressible Euler equations in a half-plane, with a particular focus on the instability mechanism driven purely by temperature variations.

data.topic: 强关联费米子体系中的混态纠缠代理与量子临界性
data.speaker: 王佛泓
data.speakerBio: 王佛泓, 2022年本科毕业于中山大学物理学院,现为上海交通大学物理与天文学院凝聚态物理专业博士研究生(导师:许霄琰副教授)。主要从事量子多体物理、行列式量子蒙特卡洛算法、混态量子纠缠以及强关联费米子量子临界性等方面的研究。在 PNAS 、 Nature Communications 、 Physical Review Letters 等期刊发表4篇论文。
data.abstract: 强关联费米子体系中的多体量子纠缠与量子临界性是凝聚态物理的重要前沿问题。本报告围绕行列式量子蒙特卡洛( DQMC )方法的发展与应用,介绍我们在费米子混态纠缠度量及 Dirac 费米子量子相变方面的近期进展。在混态量子纠缠方面,我们利用费米部分转置的保高斯性质,发展了在 DQMC 中无偏计算相互作用费米子 R é nyi negativity 的方法;通过对比费米部分转置的"扭曲( twisted )"与"非扭曲( untwisted )"定义在量子 - 经典交叉与有限温相变中的标度行为,揭示了 untwisted 定义的反常非单调性,表明 twisted R é nyi negativity ratio 更适合作为费米子混态纠缠的可靠代理指标。在 Dirac 费米子量子临界性方面,针对蜂窝晶格半填充 Hubbard 模型中长期存在争议的 Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg 相变,我们发展了零温投影 DQMC 的子矩阵延迟更新( Submatrix-T )算法,将模拟规模推进至上万格点( L = 72 , N = 10,368 ),并结合系统的有限尺寸标度分析厘清了不同临界指数的收敛规律,更新了该普适类的临界指数。

data.topic: Female Leaders' Adaptive Responses to AI-related Gender Stereotypes: A Study Based on Social Cognitive Career Theory
data.location: 大学城校园文2栋301会议室
data.speaker: 李馨
data.speakerBio: 李馨,暨南大学管理学博士,华南师范大学经济与管理学院青年英才、特聘副研究员。主要研究领域为职场人机协同、领导力和能动性。研究成果发表在Journal of Organizational Behavior、Journal of Occupational and Organizational Psychology、International Journal of Contemporary Hospitality Management及《心理学报》《心理科学进展》等国内外权威学术期刊,相关成果被人大复印报刊资料全文转载。
data.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in managerial work, making AI-related gender stereotypes more salient. These stereotypes are generalized social beliefs that portray men as more capable of, better suited to, and more legitimate in engaging with AI-related tasks or leadership roles, thereby shaping female leaders' career-relevant experiences and responses. Drawing on Social Cognitive Career Theory, this research examines how female leaders interpret and respond to AI-related gender stereotypes. Across three studies using an implicit association test (Study 1), an experiment (Study 2), and a multi-wave survey (Study 3), we find that AI-related gender stereotypes heighten female leaders' anticipated career barriers facing women employees, which in turn motivates adaptive leadership responses, including AI-supportive and collaboration-facilitating leadership behaviors. Moreover, a gender equality climate weakens the extent to which stereotypes translate into anticipated barriers. By centering on female leaders and focusing on career-relevant consequences of AI-related gender stereotypes, this study advances understanding of how gendered beliefs surrounding AI shape leadership experiences and responses in AI-intensive organizations.

data.abstract: We discuss radial stability and prescribed Q-curvature for four-dimensional metrics with two conical singularities. Using spectral analysis and finite-dimensional reduction, we establish a global radial stability estimate for a conic Adams–Onofri inequality, with an optimal quadratic remainder. We also construct metrics for small curvature perturbations supported away from the singularities, preserving both cone orders and total curvature, and give conditions for local uniqueness.

data.speaker: 邓圣兵
data.speakerBio: 邓圣兵,西南大学数学与统计学院教授、博士生导师。2013年于智利大学获博士学位,2014年8月入职西南大学数学与统计学院。2014年入选重庆市高层次人才"第四类人才",2019年获重庆市自然科学基金杰出青年基金,2024年入选重庆市学术技术带头人。兼任欧美同学会拉美分会副会长、重庆市科技青年联合会第七届理事会理事等。主要从事非线性泛函分析、偏微分方程及其应用的研究,相关成果发表于《Science China Mathematics》《Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society》《Journal of Functional Analysis》《Journal of Differential Equations》等国际期刊。先后主持国家自然科学基金项目3项、省部级项目3项、重庆市高等教育教学改革研究项目2项。重庆市一流本科课程《泛函分析》负责人,重庆市本科高校课程思政教学名师和团队负责人。
data.abstract: We discuss nondegeneracy, stability and concentration for exponential biharmonic Choquard equations in dimension four. We first establish bubble nondegeneracy and global quantitative stability for the associated Adams-Choquard inequality. Using Lyapunov- Schmidt reduction, we then construct multi-bubble solutions in bounded domains. At nondegenerate critical configurations of the interaction function, we also obtain local uniqueness, nondegeneracy and the Morse index. Finally, we briefly discuss compactness and degree results for low-energy solutions on the sphere.

data.title: Yue Zhao——Gravitational wave probes to new physics beyond the Standard Model
data.topic: Gravitational wave probes to new physics beyond the Standard Model
data.speaker: Yue Zhao
data.speakerAffiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
data.speakerBio: Yue Zhao is a theoretical particle physicist who focuses on searching for new physics and understanding dark matter. He got his B.S. from Peking University and Ph.D. from Rutgers University. He did his postdoc at Stanford and U. of Michigan. He joined the Physics & Astronomy Department at the University of Utah in 2018, and he moved to Hong Kong University Science and Technology in 2025. Now he is the Associate Director of IAS Center for Fundamental Physics.
data.abstract: This talk will explore how gravitational-wave interferometers can serve as powerful probes of new physics across vastly different mass scales. I will first show that data from the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration can help resolve a long-standing puzzle: whether the GeV gamma-ray excess at the Galactic Center originates from annihilating weakly interacting massive particles or from a population of milisecond pulsars. Turning to lighter dark matter candidates, I will then demonstrate how the same gravitational-wave detectors enable the direct detection of several species of ultralight bosons, including dark photons, axions, and dilatons. Finally, I will present recent efforts to bring dark radiation into the scope of multi-messenger astronomy. More explicitly, we demonstrate how to fully utilize information from gravitational-wave channel physics to search for dark radiation from black hole mergers using quantum sensing techniques. Together, these methods illustrate how GW channels can form powerful discovery tools for new physics.
